context: Two same-cohort coworkers discuss inventory errors
purpose: Teach: ボード/部下/発注/切り替え/エラー/同期/私立/志向

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ゆきさん、ちょっとホワイトボード見てくれる？また発注ミスのエラー表示が出てるんだよ。
lines.en: Yuki, can you check the whiteboard? Another order error is showing up again.
lines.style: Slightly stressed tone, asking a same-year coworker for a quick second opinion

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あ、本当だ。在庫データの同期がうまくいってないのかな。
lines.en: Oh, you're right. Maybe the inventory data sync isn't going through properly.
lines.style: Calm, analytical tone reviewing the board with a familiar colleague

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うちの部下が画面の切り替えのタイミングを間違えたみたいで、二重発注になってる。
lines.en: It seems my junior mistimed the screen switch and ended up double-ordering.
lines.style: Apologetic and slightly embarrassed about a subordinate's mistake

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うわー、それは厳しいね。まあ、あんまり責めすぎないであげてね。
lines.en: Ouch, that's rough. Well, try not to be too hard on him, okay?
lines.style: Warm, frank tone speaking casually with a same-cohort colleague

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: わかってるよ。彼、私立の大学出たばかりで、まだ慣れてないしね。
lines.en: I know. He just came out of a private university and isn't used to things yet.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly defensive of the younger employee in a casual aside

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うちの上、効率志向の人ばっかりだから、新人には特に厳しく感じるよね。
lines.en: The bosses here are all the efficiency-minded type, so it feels especially harsh for newcomers.
lines.style: Sympathetic, slightly critical observation about the higher-ups in casual tone

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: とりあえず、僕がもう一度発注書を確認して、システムを再起動してみるよ。
lines.en: For now, I'll double-check the order form myself and try restarting the system.
lines.style: Resolved, taking responsibility as the senior on the task at hand

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、それがいいね。終わったらコーヒーでも飲みに行こう、気持ちの切り替えも大事だよ。
lines.en: Yeah, good plan. Let's grab coffee after — switching gears mentally matters too.
lines.style: Friendly, supportive close inviting a casual break together
